wind.of.label: OpenFOAM (add-on)
wind.of.note: Runs your own OpenFOAM installation through a small helper program on this computer: one steady RANS (k-epsilon) case per wind direction, atmospheric boundary layer inlet. Nothing leaves this computer. CadCraft does not include OpenFOAM.
wind.of.down: The helper did not answer ({why}). Start it on this computer: node cc-openfoam-runner.mjs serve
wind.of.nofoam: The helper answered but could not start OpenFOAM: {why}
wind.of.install: Install OpenFOAM (the ESI v-series, openfoam.com) and the helper from the add-on's folder; the help topic explains both.
